CHALDEAN-REPEATS-001.say: You are good at communicating but find it hard to express yourself, and you like being alone.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-002.say: You communicate and express yourself well, make friends easily and are a good speaker.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-003.say: You are mostly talkative, about 80%, with a 20% introvert side.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-004.say: You may struggle to communicate and become self-absorbed, and people may think you proud before they know you.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-005.say: You are sensitive, emotional and intuitive but tend to ignore your intuition. Little things can offend you.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-006.say: You are highly intuitive and sensitive, and others often find you hard to understand.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-007.say: You are introverted and overly sensitive by nature.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-008.say: Tiny things can hurt you deeply, which can lead to depression and poor mental health, so take care of your mind.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-009.say: You have a sharp, creative mind and wide knowledge.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-010.say: You are a good leader and speaker, and art or writing can be your career. Take care that knowledge does not make you arrogant.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-011.say: You are very creative and think ahead of your time, but you may often get into arguments.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-012.say: You may struggle to fit in with society and can be impractical.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-013.say: You invest smartly in organisations and can profit from it; you are also artistic and a good debater.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-014.say: You have 'magic in your hands', and you are organised and transparent.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-015.say: You may struggle a lot in life and not reach your full potential.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-016.say: You tend to detach yourself from worldly things.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-017.say: You are excitable, open-minded, a perfectionist and good at business. You are caring, but quick to anger.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-018.say: You show willpower in difficult times and take risks, which can bring you success. Take care of laziness and over-explaining.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-020.say: You are the centre of your family and often have a love marriage, but you can feel insecure easily.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-021.say: You are deeply attached to your family and can be materialistic.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-022.say: Extreme attachment to family can bring insecurity and negativity and become a hurdle in your growth.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-023.say: You may feel confused emotions and dissatisfaction, and someone may break your heart at least once. Your intuition is strong, but you may see yourself negatively.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-024.say: Your first love may be drawn to personality and the second to the mind. You have a gift for healing and can build a successful career in occult science.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-025.say: Linked with heavy losses of money and health, confusion, and married life losing peace over time, so take extra care in these areas.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-026.say: You are a multitasker and make good financial decisions.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-027.say: You make quick decisions that may backfire and are always in a hurry. Managing money can be difficult, so take care.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-028.say: You can be stubborn and narrow-minded, face a lot of struggle, and feel greed for money.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-030.say: You have strong willpower and intelligence, do charitable things and value people.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-031.say: You value relationships, are intelligent and say the right thing at the right time, but anger can be an issue.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-032.say: You love praise and are charitable, but your anger can ruin relationships, so keep it in check.

CHALDEAN-REPEATS-033.say: You can be unpredictable and may start to believe you can change the world.
